strategy_lineage: result-informed production-path continuation of ATM-SVP2-US-VALUE-ROLE-001; frozen nfci-dual-core-v11 / dualcore-v11-2026-08-15 target and execution-event path
hypothesis: The prior common-window value-role trial suggested positive value-role incremental returns but restarted all portfolios from cash, which mixed role substitution with a path reset. Replaying the same two preregistered value instruments on the full frozen production V11 path can isolate whether IWD or VBR improves the sp500 realized-return role while preserving all V11 signals, target weights, execution events, gross exposure, fees, and cash policy.

prior_evidence_disclosure.anti_survivorship_rule: both predecessor candidates IWD and VBR are carried forward; neither can be dropped or selected before this trial
prior_evidence_disclosure.g3_policy: both new production-path candidates are additional formal attempts and are added to the complete post-protocol trial count

allowed_changes: preserve the full frozen V11 history from its original start rather than restarting all portfolios from cash in 2004
S-IWD-PROD-SP500-ROLE replaces only the realized return under the frozen V11 sp500 portfolio role with IWD adjusted-close return from 2004-02-02 onward
S-VBR-PROD-SP500-ROLE performs the identical role substitution using VBR
before 2004-02-02 both candidates use the original frozen S&P role return and are identical to production V11
on union-calendar dates without a new value-ETF quote, carry the last adjusted close forward so that role return is zero on that date and the next quote realizes the full close-to-close ETF return
the V11 source full target fingerprint must remain ba67c8aa24bc7168 and both candidate execution-event target fingerprints must equal the source execution-event fingerprint
selection_metric: No winner selection. Both result-informed value-role candidates are independently compared with the same production-path V11 and both remain in G3/global DSR accounting regardless of outcome.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe in the same fold

deterministic: source production V11 full target fingerprint exactly equals ba67c8aa24bc7168; candidate execution-event target fingerprints equal the source execution-event target fingerprint; target gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or shorting
bootstrap on 2004-02-02+ behavior: paired circular moving blocks versus V11, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO/winner-selection test: not applicable because both candidates are independently reported and no family winner is selected
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using the prior 38 performance-bearing formal candidates plus both new candidates, total 40
ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This result-informed production-path value campaign ends after both candidates are opened. Do not blend IWD/VBR with S&P or each other, change the 2004-02-02 start, substitute only part of the sp500 role, add a third value ETF, alter the calendar carry-forward rule, add timing or valuation gates, change V11 targets/events, add leverage, or rerun a nicer variant. A future value hypothesis must be materially new, independently motivated, preregistered, and counted as a new trial family.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_us_value_production_role_v1.py -> tools/us_value_production_role_v1.swiftpart -> full frozen V11 source path + IWD/VBR hybrid sp500-role realized-return series -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: full-history V11-CONTROL metrics and source full target fingerprint ba67c8aa24bc7168
S-IWD-PROD-SP500-ROLE and S-VBR-PROD-SP500-ROLE full-history disclosure plus 2004-02-02+ primary metrics
identity replay and exact execution-event target-fingerprint equality with V11
mechanical deterministic admission flags for both candidates
paired 20000-replicate bootstrap statistics for both candidates
cumulative 40-performance-candidate DSR for both candidates using post-substitution behavior
mechanical ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS flags for both candidates
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 artifact manifest
forbidden_changes: dropping either IWD or VBR from this result-informed continuation
any frozen V11 signal, parameter, event date, target sizing, or target-path change
any substitution fraction other than exactly 100% of the sp500 realized-return role
any alternative value ETF or third candidate
any value timing, moving average, momentum, valuation, volatility, or regime gate
any substitution-start change after performance is viewed
any leverage, financing, negative target weights, or gross above 100%
using IWD/VBR prices to alter V11 signals or target weights
